meta.title: Request a quote: {name}
meta.description: Send the spec, quantities and files for {name}. The Packio team prices it and replies within the stated time.

heading: Request a quote: {name}
intro: Tell us what you need. Our team prices it with our partner factories and sends you a quotation.

how.step1: Give the spec and quantities, attach files
how.step2: We price it and send a quotation
how.step3: Accept the price and order straight away

form.dimensionsHint: Not sure yet? Give a rough size and our team will confirm it.
form.quantitiesHint: Ask for up to {count} quantities to compare
form.filesHint: Sketches, reference photos or artwork help us price it accurately
form.fileRules: Up to {max} each, at most {count} files
form.wrongType: {name} is not a supported file type
form.stillUploading: Please wait for the files to finish uploading
form.notesHint: For example what goes in it, its weight, special finishes
form.sla: Our team replies within {hours} business hours
form.signInNote: When you send it you will be asked to sign in with your mobile number, so our team can reach you. Nothing you typed is lost.
form.fixErrors: {count, plural, one {# thing needs} other {# things need}} fixing
form.failed: We could not send the request. Your answers are still here — please try again.
form.fromProduct: Sent here from {name}: this spec needs our team to price it. Fill in the details below.

list.title: My quote requests
list.intro: Follow your requests and the quotations our team sends you
list.emptyBody: Products without an instant price can be quoted from their product page.

detail.title: Quote request
detail.heading: Quote request: {type}
detail.submitted: Request {code} sent. We will let you know by e-mail and LINE when the quotation is ready.
detail.declinedTitle: We are not able to quote this request
detail.noQuotesYet: No quotation yet — our team is pricing it.
detail.confirmBody: Accept the price for request {code}: {quantity} pieces, {amount} in total incl. VAT. The quantity cannot be changed afterwards, but nothing is paid until you order.
detail.acceptFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
detail.acceptedBody: {quantity} pieces. Add it to your cart to order.
detail.cartFailed: We could not add it to your cart. Please try again.
